_comment: Warren stub relays.json - Warren tunnels via Quinn over wallet identity, not WireGuard. This file satisfies the legacy Check relays build script (checkRelays.swift) which requires a non-empty wireguard.relays array. Real relay selection in Warren happens at runtime via warren-api-client (see Settings -> Diagnostic info for the active session's exit relay). Slated for removal in C.4.5 once the Mullvad Device/relay flows are fully migrated.
